ValidationRule.description: CR-13 / CFG-14: the line's billing frequency must be one the product allows (Product > Allowed Billing Frequencies). Mindbody products only.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( BEGINS(Product2.ProductCode, 'MB-'), NOT(ISBLANK(Product2.Allowed_Billing_Frequencies__c)), OR( AND(ISPICKVAL(BillingFrequency, 'Monthly'), NOT(INCLUDES(Product2.Allowed_Billing_Frequencies__c, 'Monthly'))) , AND(ISPICKVAL(BillingFrequency, 'Quarterly'), NOT(INCLUDES(Product2.Allowed_Billing_Frequencies__c, 'Quarterly'))) , AND(ISPICKVAL(BillingFrequency, 'Semi-Annual'), NOT(INCLUDES(Product2.Allowed_Billing_Frequencies__c, 'Semi-Annual'))) , AND(ISPICKVAL(BillingFrequency, 'Annual'), NOT(INCLUDES(Product2.Allowed_Billing_Frequencies__c, 'Annual'))) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This billing frequency is not offered for this product. Allowed: see the product's Allowed Billing Frequencies (e.g. Starter: Monthly or Annual).
